💬 After the deepam: sorakaya pappu or tomato pappu? 👇

Save this Karthika Monday recipe (serves 3) 👇
🛒 You need: ½ bottle gourd, peeled and cubed · ¾ cup toor dal · 1 tomato · 2 green chillies · ¼ tsp turmeric · salt · 1 tsp tamarind pulp · tadka: 1 tbsp ghee, mustard, cumin, 2 dry red chillies, a pinch of hing, curry leaves
1️⃣ Rinse the dal and pressure-cook with the gourd, tomato, chillies, turmeric and 2 cups water for 3 whistles.
2️⃣ Mash lightly, add salt and tamarind, simmer 5 minutes.
3️⃣ Pour the tadka on top and serve hot with rice.
